strategy: NQ Scalping System (user-supplied Pine v6): EMA89 trend + pullback to EMA8/EMA21 + StochRSI reset and cross
instrument: NAS 15m, 206,703 bars, 2016-11-14 to 2025-10-01, byte-identical to the file used in the Donchian study
note_no_flatten: The Pine gates ENTRIES by session but has no session exit, so a position can run for days. Both variants are measured.
intrabar_problem: The trailing stop (arm 15 pts, offset 8 pts) is path-dependent and the median hold is 1 bar. A 15m OHLC file cannot order prices inside a bar, so every headline is bracketed under three exit conventions: intrabar-favorable, intrabar-adverse, and barclose (trail may only arm or tighten from CLOSED bars).
primary_model: trail_mode=barclose, order=adverse. It makes no claim a 15m file cannot support. intrabar is reported as the optimistic bracket, not as the result.
split: first 65% of sessions research, last 35% holdout, chronological on sessions
holdout_status: This NAS holdout was read twice for the Donchian study. This strategy is a different family and was specified by the user, not selected by me on this data, so it gets ONE look at the configurations declared below.
pass_criterion: PASS on the holdout requires, for the primary model: (a) net expectancy > 0 after costs, AND (b) excess over the matched control with p < 0.01 (Bonferroni for NPRE=5). Reporting a PASS under the intrabar convention alone is explicitly NOT a pass.
prior: Trail-off expectancy is already negative on the full sample (-1.11 to -2.09 pts/trade), and random entries pushed through the same trailing exit earn +2.47 to +4.04 pts/trade under the intrabar convention. Prior expectation: the profit is the exit mechanic interacting with the bar model, and the signal contributes about +1 pt/trade over random, which is roughly the size of the round-turn cost. Recorded so a positive result cannot be framed as expected and a negative one cannot be framed as surprising.
searches_allowed: Parameter sensitivity, walk-forward re-selection and all Monte Carlo work happen on the RESEARCH block only.

when: Recorded BEFORE any holdout number was produced. The holdout has not been opened for this study.
reason: A search over 5 session windows on the research block found that restricting to 09:30-11:00 New York (08:30-10:00 Chicago) is the only variant positive after costs under the primary path-free model. It also beats the matched control on research (excess +3.19 pts/trade, p 0.0275 at barclose/adverse). It is the single most promising thing in the study and deserves a holdout look rather than being reported as an unresolved research finding.
multiplicity_it_carries: Best of 5 windows searched. On research its nominal p 0.0275 becomes ~0.14 after a Bonferroni correction for those 5, so it is NOT significant on research once the search is priced in. The holdout test is what decides it.
new_test: 6. RTH sub-window 09:30-11:00 New York, as-written parameters otherwise, barclose/adverse (primary) - the other conventions reported alongside but not counted.
pass_criterion_unchanged: PASS still requires expectancy > 0 after costs AND excess over the matched control below the Bonferroni threshold, on the PRIMARY path-free model. A pass under the intrabar convention alone is explicitly not a pass.
prior: The research-block excess is not significant after correcting for the 5-window search, and the sub-window has only 299 research trades. Prior expectation: it does not survive.

verdict: NO VALIDATED EDGE. 0 of 7 pre-registered holdout comparisons pass at p<0.0083.
headline: The entire backtested profit is the intrabar path assumption for the trailing stop. Research block: intrabar +2.75 to +4.10 pts/trade, path-free barclose -1.31 to -0.55, no trail at all -1.86 to -1.16.

barclose.dsr_verdict: not distinguishable from the best of 729 random tries

intrabar.dsr_verdict: not distinguishable from the best of 729 random tries

decisive_holdout_number: intrabar/adverse: strategy +4.70 pts/trade vs matched control +4.50, excess +0.20 (p 0.4375), down from +1.60 on research. Out of sample the signal adds nothing and the exit mechanic adds everything.
gross_vs_cost: Honest gross edge +0.45 pts/trade against a 1.74-pt round turn on MNQ. Breakeven needs a 0.39-pt round turn. Costs are ~4x the edge.
walkforward_note: barclose FAIL (22%/0% folds profitable); intrabar PASS (89%/100%). Walk-forward certifies an execution artifact as robust - it tests parameter stability, not fill realism.
deflated_sharpe_note: Even the optimistic model fails deflation: observed ann. Sharpe +1.19 vs +1.16 expected from the best of 729 random tries; DSR 0.539. 67% of its P&L is the top 1% of days.
actionable: (1) 1-minute data is the only test that settles this. (2) Full-size NQ instead of MNQ moves the cost floor from 1.74 to 0.62 pts. (3) 09:30-11:00 NY is the only positive window on the honest model, but it failed the holdout at p 0.2225 on 177 trades.
pine_defect: inSession gates entries only; the script has no session exit, so positions can run past the window (longest 85 bars). Worth ~1% of P&L but not what the description says.
engine_verification: truncation 0.0e+00, execution alignment clean, Wilder ATR/RSI to 1e-13, leakage audit no critical or warning findings, no same-bar execution signature.

block: RESEARCH ONLY - holdout not opened for this round
request: User asked to optimise the signal so it passes the tests; then clarified the entry signal is the moving average.
model: All numbers under the path-free barclose/adverse exit model. Optimising under intrabar would tune the artifact.
mechanistic_defect_found: Every distance threshold is in FIXED POINTS over a 5x price range. The trailing stop arm falls from 3.27 ATR in 2016 to 0.40 ATR in 2022 and the offset from 1.75 to 0.21 ATR; the 15-point pullback filter binds on 34% of in-session bars in 2016 and 99.4% in 2022, so by the end of the sample it filters nothing.
phaseB_ma_search: 165 MA structures (3 types x 5 trend periods x fast/slow pairs). 165 of 165 net positive; 145 at p<0.05 vs matched control. ALL MA TYPES WITHIN 0.2 pts OF EACH OTHER (ema +3.82, hma +3.94, sma +3.76). The MA structure is interchangeable - it is not the lever.
placebo: Random triggers at the same rate inside the same trend+pullback+window context: real +5.65 vs placebo median +0.32, p=0.0000. The StochRSI cross does discriminate ON RESEARCH.
concentration: 2020 +12.40/trade and 2022 +23.01/trade against +0.07 to +1.22 in every other year (2019 negative). Top 5% of trades = 78% of P&L. Shorts +9.71 vs longs +1.91.
drop_one_year: Dropping 2020 AND 2022 leaves +0.45 pts/trade against a 0.62-pt round turn on full-size NQ - a loss.
walkforward: FAIL both configurations. 400/150: 56% folds profitable, stitched +3.27 CI [-1.72,+8.42]. 600/200: 40% profitable, stitched +0.78 CI [-4.12,+5.88]. Fold OOS: +1.09 +4.15 -2.92 -0.14 -2.26 +16.92 -0.75 +1.12 +19.26 - two folds carry everything.
verdict: The optimisation did NOT produce a strategy that passes. It produced a concentrated volatility bet on 2020 and 2022 expressed through ~13 trades. Nothing earned a holdout look, so the holdout was NOT opened.
prior_evidence: The RTH window effect was already tested on the holdout in the previous round with the original parameters: +0.24 pts/trade, excess +2.29, p 0.2225 on 177 trades. It did not replicate out of sample there either.
multiplicity: 5 session windows + 165 MA structures + 240 filter/geometry cells searched on research.

block: RESEARCH ONLY on both instruments; NAS holdout NOT opened
gate: G1 net>round turn, G2 excess over matched control p<0.05, G3 still above round turn without 2020+2022, G4 stable across 250-session blocks, G5 replicates on the second instrument. Declared before running.
cross_instrument: The signal does not replicate on US30 - it inverts. All three configurations disagree in sign; US30 excess is negative in every one at p 0.79-0.95. The RTH window is +0.323 ATR gross on NAS and -0.210 ATR on US30.
condition_correlations: Pullback depth and MA touch correlate 0.53 and fire on 71% and 75% of bars. The StochRSI %K/%D cross is the only independent selective condition (corr 0.00-0.04, fires 12.2%). US30 matrix matches NAS to two decimals.
what_to_delete: Nothing has positive worth on both instruments. The two with negative worth on BOTH are the pullback depth (-0.08 NAS, -0.10 US30) and the MA touch (-0.29, -0.41) - the two conditions that define the strategy. Quick scalp is the worst feature measured; all four early exits are negative on NAS.
stochrsi_sweep: 486 configs per instrument. NAS: 6/243 above the round turn, 0 surviving removal of 2020+2022. US30: 0 above the round turn. Every marginal negative on both.
verdict: 0 of 3 finalists pass every gate on both instruments. The volume-thrust filter is 4/4 on NAS (+1.55 pts/trade, excess +2.54 p 0.028, ex-crisis +1.03, 86% of blocks positive) and 0/4 on US30 (-5.56, excess -3.08 p 0.868). Best single finding in the study and it is sample-specific.
holdout: NOT opened. Nothing earned the look.
